title: Living the Gospel Joyful
author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
calling_raw: Second Counselor in the First Presidency
notes_text: 1.  God is not only our Ruler and Creator; He is also our Heavenly Father. All men and women are literally the sons and daughters of God. President Joseph F. Smith taught that “man, as a spirit, was begotten and born of heavenly parents, and reared to maturity in the eternal mansions of the Father, prior to coming upon the earth in a temporal [physical] body” ( Teachings of Presidents of the Church: Joseph F. Smith [1998], 335).
